subject: pharmacology
title: Carbapenems and Aztreonam: Imipenem, Meropenem and the Monobactam

steps.tx: **Imipenem**, the first carbapenem, marries the broadest beta lactam spectrum (Gram positives, Gram negatives including Pseudomonas, and anaerobes) to a renal assassin: dehydropeptidase I in the brush border hydrolyses it, so it is co formulated with cilastatin, an inhibitor with no antibacterial action that simply bodyguards it through the kidney. Seizures, especially with renal impairment, CNS lesions and excessive dose, are imipenem's signature beyond meropenem's calmer profile.
steps.say: Imipenem needs cilastatin as a kidney bodyguard and carries the family's seizure accent.

right.title: Meropenem
points: Slightly weaker Gram positive, stronger Gram negative
Febrile neutropenia and intra abdominal staple

steps.tx: **Meropenem** refined the class for meningitis and febrile neutropenia, ertapenem deliberately surrendered Pseudomonas and enterococcus for once daily convenience in community intra abdominal and pelvic infections, and doripenem fills regional formularies between them. All carbapenems share the boundaries: no MRSA, no atypicals, no Enterococcus faecium reliability, and vulnerability to carbapenemases (KPC, metallo enzymes) that the new inhibitor pairs from previous lessons chase with incomplete success.
steps.say: Carbapenems cover almost everything except MRSA, atypicals and their own carbapenemases.

left.title: Carbapenem family
points: Ertapenem: once daily, no Pseudomonas cover
All: anaerobes and ESBL producers covered

steps.tx: **Aztreonam**, the monobactam, is a single ring with Gram negative only vision (including Pseudomonas) and a life changing allergy property: negligible cross reactivity with penicillins and cephalosporins (except, famously, ceftazidime, with which it shares an identical side chain), making it the beta lactam refuge in serious beta lactam allergy for Gram negative cover. Inhaled aztreonam serves cystic fibrosis Pseudomonas suppression in rotation with tobramycin.
steps.say: Aztreonam sees only Gram negatives and forgives beta lactam allergy, except its ceftazidime twin.

nodes.label: Serious beta lactam allergy with Gram negative sepsis
Aztreonam covers Gram negatives including Pseudomonas
Gram positive partner added (vancomycin) as indicated
Ceftazidime allergy history: shared side chain caution

steps.tx: **Carbapenem stewardship is** the class's survival contract: reserve for ESBL producers, severe polymicrobial sepsis and defined empirical niches, because every empirical course selects carbapenemase carriers in the unit's ecology. Carbapenem sparing strategies (pip tazo for low risk ESBL urinary sources by trial nuance, cefepime for AmpC, source control shortening courses) are argued patient by patient with infectious diseases, never by habit in either direction.
steps.say: Carbapenems are spent by the course and saved by the culture; argue each one.

left.title: Carbapenem justified
points: Severe polymicrobial sepsis with resistance risk

right.title: Carbapenem spared
points: Low risk urinary ESBL by specialist judgement
Short courses with source control achieved

steps.tx: **Valproate levels collapse** by 60 to 90 percent within a day of carbapenem co therapy (glucuronidation induced and recycling blocked), provoking seizures in epilepsy patients in one of pharmacology's most absolute interaction prohibitions: the combination is avoided outright, and if carbapenems are unavoidable, alternative seizure prophylaxis is specialist built. Carbapenems also lower thresholds themselves, compounding the vignette both pharmacologically and examinably.
steps.say: Carbapenems erase valproate in a day; that combination is forbidden, not monitored.

nodes.label: Alternative seizure plan built with specialists

steps.tx: **Ertapenem's once daily**, Pseudomonas free design teaches spectrum subtraction as strategy: community acquired intra abdominal infection, diabetic foot without Pseudomonas risk and pelvic sepsis gain a single daily dose and outpatient parenteral feasibility, while any Pseudomonas probability (prior colonisation, bronchiectasis, recent broad antibiotics) disqualifies it in favour of meropenem or pip tazo. Reading which pathogen a carbapenem omits is as examinable as which it covers.
steps.say: Ertapenem omits Pseudomonas on purpose; any Pseudomonas probability disqualifies it.

left.title: Ertapenem suited
points: High protein binding, long half life

steps.tx: **Aztreonam's second career** is combination chemistry: because metallo beta lactamases destroy every beta lactam except aztreonam (which they cannot hydrolyse, though co produced ESBLs and AmpC can), aztreonam plus avibactam (shielding it from those companions) treats metallo producers, the cleverest spectrum chess in the modern cabinet. The lesson generalises: know which enzyme defeats which molecule, and combinations become deductions instead of memoranda.
steps.say: Aztreonam survives metallo enzymes and avibactam shields it from their friends; enzyme chess wins infections.

nodes.label: Aztreonam intrinsically stable to the metallo enzyme
Avibactam shields aztreonam from co produced enzymes
Combination treats otherwise untouchable Gram negatives

steps.tx: **Beta lactam infusion** science closes the class: extended (3 to 4 hour) or continuous infusions of meropenem, pip tazo and cefepime maximise time above MIC and improve outcomes in critically ill and resistant infection meta analyses, at the cost of line occupancy and stability arithmetic. Loading doses precede them because time dependent killing punishes slow starts in septic shock most of all.
steps.say: Extend the infusion to extend the killing; load first because septic shock cannot wait for steady state.

left.title: Extended infusion gains
points: Time above MIC maximised for resistant isolates
Meropenem, pip tazo and cefepime protocols
Mortality signals in severe sepsis analyses

right.title: Practical costs
points: Not needed for low MIC community isolates
